theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → Bijective φ → (∀ x, Injective (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → (∀ x, x ∉ K → φ x = x) → ∃ Λ : NNReal, LipschitzWith Λ φ ∧ AntilipschitzWith Λ φ ∧ φ ⁻¹' U = U
